note: Display Field Copy is a Display Suite add-on. It has no settings form (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, and defines no plugin TYPE - it provides one DsField plugin 'display_field_copy' derived per configured copy. A copy is a Display Suite dynamic field stored as a SIMPLE config object ds.field.<id> with type=display_field_copy and properties.field_id=<entity_type>[.<bundle>].<field>. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: introspection reads the source field of a known copy; execution builds a copy and verifies the ds.field.* object. Requires the ds module (enabled).

evals.prompt: In Drupal, what does the display_field_copy module let you do, and which contrib module does it require to work?
evals.expected_output: It is a Display Suite (ds) add-on that lets you render the same entity field more than once on a display, each copy using its own formatter and settings. It requires the Display Suite (ds) module.

evals.prompt: A display_field_copy field 'copy' is not a settings form. Where is a copy stored in Drupal configuration, and what identifies it as a display_field_copy rather than another Display Suite field?
evals.expected_output: Each copy is a simple config object named ds.field.<id> with type: display_field_copy and properties.field_id pointing at the source field (<entity_type>.<field> or <entity_type>.<bundle>.<field>). There is no configure route.

evals.prompt: How do I create a copy of a field with display_field_copy through the admin UI, and where do I then choose its formatter?
must_contain_any: Create a copy of a field
evals.expected_output: Go to Structure > Display Suite > Fields (/admin/structure/ds/fields), click 'Create a copy of a field', pick the source field and save; then on the entity's Manage display the copy appears as a DS field where you enable it and choose a formatter.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Display Suite field copy created with display_field_copy, named dfc_known. Inspect the live configuration and state which source field it copies (the field_id).
evals.expected_output: ds.field.dfc_known has type display_field_copy and properties.field_id: node.article.body, i.e. it copies the Article body field.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use display_field_copy to create a Display Suite field copy named dfc_task that copies the Article node's body field (source field id node.article.body). Apply the change to the live site so the copy exists in configuration.
evals.expected_output: A simple config object ds.field.dfc_task exists with type: display_field_copy and properties.field_id: node.article.body (plus label, type_label 'Copy field', entities: {node: node}). Create it by saving that config or via Structure > Display Suite > Fields > Create a copy of a field.
